title: Unglued: Making Wise Choices in the Midst of Raw Emotions
author: Lysa TerKeurst
target_audience: Women seeking spiritual and emotional growth
Readers who struggle with emotional outbursts or instability
Christian audiences looking for faith-based approaches to managing emotions
Individuals interested in personal development and relationships
core_themes: Spiritual growth and faith as tools for self-regulation
Making wise choices during emotionally charged situations
The impact of emotional responses on relationships
primary_purpose: To provide readers, particularly women, with faith-based, practical guidance for managing emotional reactions and making wise, intentional choices even in the midst of difficult circumstances.

structure_format.narrative_style: Conversational, relatable, and story-driven with a faith-based tone
structure_format.organization: Organized into chapters addressing different types of emotional responses, biblical insights, and actionable steps

key_concepts_lessons: Emotional reactivity can be understood, managed, and transformed.
There are four main responses to raw emotions: exploding, stuffing, exploding then blaming, and stuffing then smiling.
Awareness of emotional triggers leads to more thoughtful responses.
Faith and reliance on God are central to the journey of self-control and transformation.
It’s possible to have imperfect progress—growth isn’t always linear.
Practical techniques, like pause and prayer, can help interrupt emotional spirals.
Relationships benefit when we handle emotions wisely and communicate honestly, but kindly.
notable_features: Biblically grounded advice and scripture integration
Personal stories that foster reader relatability
Practical tips interwoven with spiritual lessons
Discussion questions for group or individual reflection
Workbook, study guides, and companion resources available
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2012 amid a growing cultural emphasis on emotional intelligence and mental health, 'Unglued' stands out by combining these insights with Christian spirituality, targeting the unique emotional challenges faced by women in contemporary society.
reception_impact: Became a bestseller in Christian Living and Women’s Self-Help categories
Praised for its openness, practical application, and scriptural foundation
Widely used in women’s groups, churches, and personal study
Critics sometimes note the strong focus on a Christian worldview may not appeal to secular audiences
comparable_titles: She’s Still There: Rescuing the Girl in You by Chrystal Evans Hurst
Emotionally Healthy Spirituality by Peter Scazzero
Boundaries by Dr. Henry Cloud & Dr. John Townsend
